text:
sara-support: FYI customer ACME infra — CI jobs started failing right after they turned on org-wide MFA enforcement. Builds that use an API key started getting 401s. Short snippet from customer: {"error":"mfa_required","reason":"user_action_required"}

morgan-support: Got logs from customer, pasting curl response they sent:
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "mfa_required",
  "error_description": "user enrolled in MFA, interactive auth required",
  "hint": "API keys tied to user sessions may be revoked on MFA enrollment"
}
```

sara-support: Customer insists this was a machine key used by CI — they say it's a key created by a teammate and dropped into Vault. They want to know why MFA would affect an API key used non-interactively.

alex-identity: Short answer: personal API keys are user-scoped credentials. When a user enrolls in MFA or a security policy triggers a re-auth, our system may mark user-scoped keys for rotation/revocation depending on how they were issued (session-bound vs machine-level). Service/machine keys created at the org level are unaffected.

noah-sre: Can we get repro material before telling them to rotate? Ask for: 1) full request/response headers (x-request-id), 2) key creation screenshot (Personal vs Machine), 3) audit log lines near the time of failure.

morgan-support: They provided the screenshot — key was created inside the Console while logged in as alice@acme.com (personal key). They also included request id `req_01Gk5X6T9` and audit log line: `auth:revoke actor=user:alice@acme.com reason=mfa_enroll target=api_key:sk_live_XXXXX ts=2025-11-02T15:12:08Z`

alex-identity: That audit line matches expected behavior: enrolling in MFA for a user triggers a security flow that can revoke personal keys (to prevent persistent credential bypass). Mitigation options: 1) create an org-scoped machine/service API key (recommended for CI), 2) use a dedicated service account with its own keys, 3) rotate the existing key (can't reissue the same key).

sara-support: I'll send those mitigation steps to the customer. They asked if we can make the Console warning clearer when creating a personal key. @noah-sre any concerns about changing dialogs? :thinking:

noah-sre: No infra impact. UX change is fine — file an internal ticket for docs/tooltip. Also recommend adding a KB snippet explaining "Why did my API key stop working after I enabled MFA".

ci-bot: Created support-ticket #5679 and internal task RED-3421 (identity:machine-keys-docs).

morgan-support: Customer accepted the immediate workaround (create machine key and rotate). They asked whether keys revoked by MFA can be restored — short answer: no, revocation is final for security.

sara-support: Closing loop with customer, documenting steps and adding KB link to the support ticket. :white_check_mark:
